english: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ''(even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out)'', the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦，在战斗场上受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害时，会令使用了招式的宝可梦陷入'''{{TCG|中毒}}'''状态。

english: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ''(even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out)'', put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon for each of your Tandemaus, Maushold, and Maushold ex in play.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦，在战斗场上受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害时，将自己场上「{{TCGPM|一对鼠}}」和「一家鼠（包含『宝可梦{{ex}}』）」的数量×3个伤害指示物，放置于使用了招式的宝可梦身上。

english: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦的HP为全满的状态下，这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害而'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''时，这只宝可梦不会'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''，而是以剩余HP为「10」的状态留在场上。

english: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害时，自己抛掷1次硬币。如果为正面，则这只宝可梦不受到该伤害。

english: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, and if you have any {{DL|Pecharunt (TCG)|Pecharunt ex}} in play, your opponent takes 1 fewer Prize card.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦，受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害而'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''时，如果自己场上有「桃歹郎{{ex}}」的话，则对手拿取的奖赏卡将减少1张。

english: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦，在战斗场上受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害时，将3个伤害指示物放置于使用了招式的宝可梦身上。

english: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ''(even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out)'', put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦，在战斗场上受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害时，将3个伤害指示物放置于使用了招式的宝可梦身上。

english: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, has a Pokémon Tool attached, and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ''(even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out)'', put 5 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦，在战斗场上受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害时，如果这只宝可梦身上放有「{{TCG|宝可梦道具}}」的话，则将5个伤害指示物放置于使用了招式的宝可梦身上。

english: If this Pokémon is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ''(even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out)'', put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon for each {{e|Metal}} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
chinese: 当这只宝可梦，受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害时，将这只宝可梦身上附着的{{e|钢}}能量数量×2个伤害指示物，放置于使用了招式的宝可梦的身上。
